description: Baseline of the previous Predictive Analytics group project. Values are copied from the paper (baseline of record) and from the saved notebook outputs.

sources.paper: Risma, Abad, Toliba - Integrating IIoT Telemetry and Machine Health Indicators for Dynamic Fire Hazard Assessment (Tables 2-4, Section 6)

data.cleaning: rows with a missing Workers value are dropped (2,000 rows); nothing else is removed
data.outliers: Pressure (508 IQR / 500 z-score) and Risk (24 / 9) outliers were kept on purpose

features.pipeline_name_rule: pipeline feature name = notebook name in lower case

engineering.temporal: Hour_of_Day, Day_of_Week (Mon=0), Is_Weekend (Sat/Sun), Month from Date+Time
engineering.binary_maps: Training Yes=1/No=0, Alarm On=1/Off=0, Exp Senior=1/Junior=0
engineering.one_hot: Factory, Region, Shift with drop_first=True (dropped: Factory_A, Industrial_Zone, Day)

baseline_rows.rule: drop rows with missing Workers, keep source file order, first int(n*0.8) rows = train
baseline_rows.key_definition: sha256 of the sorted reading timestamps (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) joined by newlines

cross_validation.data: all 98,000 cleaned rows (train and test together), file order
cross_validation.averaging: mean of the five fold values; average RMSE = mean of per-fold RMSE

tolerance_policy.rule: |reproduced - baseline| must not exceed half a unit of the last reported decimal (0.005 for 2-decimal values, 0.0005 for values reported with 3 or more decimals). This is stricter than the lab's recommended +/-0.01.
tolerance_policy.blocking: all checks marked blocking must pass, otherwise the pipeline fails
tolerance_policy.accepted_deviation: non-blocking checks are reported with the documented reason

checks.accepted_deviation: Paper Table 3 mixes two runs: its XGBoost fold R2 values match xgboost <= 3.2.0 while its XGBoost averages (17.34 / 3.94 / 3.09) match xgboost >= 3.3.0. One environment cannot reproduce both; the pinned 3.2.0 reproduces Table 2 and the fold R2 values.

Paper Table 3 mixes two runs: its XGBoost fold R2 values match xgboost <= 3.2.0 while its XGBoost averages (17.34 / 3.94 / 3.09) match xgboost >= 3.3.0. One environment cannot reproduce both; the pinned 3.2.0 reproduces Table 2 and the fold R2 values.

Paper Table 3 mixes two runs: its XGBoost fold R2 values match xgboost <= 3.2.0 while its XGBoost averages (17.34 / 3.94 / 3.09) match xgboost >= 3.3.0. One environment cannot reproduce both; the pinned 3.2.0 reproduces Table 2 and the fold R2 values.
